name: Discord Webhook
description: Posts server up/down, player joins and leaves, map changes and optionally chat to a Discord channel through a webhook.
author: OpenCitadel

webhookUrl.description: Discord webhook URL (Channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks).

events.description: What to post: server, players, maps.

username.description: Name the webhook posts as. Defaults to the server name.

batchSeconds.description: Collect messages for this long and post them together.

maxPerMinute.description: Never post more often than this.
